qa.title: Q2157 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: If I evolved this follower with its Fanfare ability, can I evolve another follower in the same turn?
qa.answer: Yes. Although you can only activate one evolve ability per turn, other abilities that evolve followers do not count towards this limit.

faces.name: Seeds of Salvation
faces.text: Draw a card. You may turn any number of faceup evolved followers in your evolve deck facedown. Gain 1 Evolution Point.
faces.raw_text: Draw a card. You may turn any number of faceup evolved followers in your evolve deck facedown. Gain 1 Evolution Point.

qa.title: Q2188 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: Can I use this spell to turn a faceup Drive Point or advanced card in my evolve deck facedown?
qa.answer: No. Drive Points and advanced cards are not evolved followers.

qa.title: Q2187 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: Can the player going first gain 1 Evolution Point with this spell's effect?
qa.answer: Yes. Also note that players can still gain 1 Evolution Point even if they currently have 3.

qa.title: Q2189 (Jul. 10, 2026)
qa.question: After I play and resolve a spell from my banished zone, where do I put it?
qa.answer: You put it into your cemetery.

qa.question: If a follower loses all its abilities, can I still give it Ward with Guardian Sun?
qa.answer: Yes. Abilities given to a follower after it lost all its abilities are still valid.
